task_description: Create documentation and implement Phase 1 of the vek language: core runtime including lexer, parser/compiler, register-based VM with NaN-boxing and computed GOTO dispatch, mark-and-sweep GC, and basic type operations (strings, lists, maps). End result: a working 'vek run file.ve' command that can execute basic vek programs.

verification.summary: Build succeeds (warnings are all from intentional computed GOTO GNU extension). All 99 unit tests pass (24 value, 18 object, 6 GC, 31 lexer, 20 compiler). All 8 integration tests pass. Semantic review approved on v3 after fixing 10 issues across 2 review iterations. Non-blocking note: GC auto-trigger is not wired in (Phase 2 concern).
